subject.title: Hard-delete or runtimeId migration needed for @apify/apify-openclaw-plugin

question: After verifying Apify controls package `rn74fp3a5j45n1qt1qrngzy4rh83m49c` and that `apify-openclaw-plugin` is unclaimed, should an administrator apply the guarded runtime-ID repair?
rationale: The repair mechanism is already implemented, but authorizing a live executable package-identity mutation requires human verification of ownership and collision safety.

options.title: Apply guarded repair
options.body: Run the admin dry-run, verify ownership and collision checks, and then migrate `apify` to `apify-openclaw-plugin` while retaining history and audit records.

options.title: Decline the migration
options.body: Leave the record unchanged and document the ownership, collision, or identity evidence that prevents a safe repair.

options.title: Hard-delete and republish
options.body: Delete the record only if guarded repair is technically impossible and maintainers explicitly accept losing its existing history.

recommendation.title: Apply guarded repair
recommendation.body: Run the admin dry-run, verify ownership and collision checks, and then migrate `apify` to `apify-openclaw-plugin` while retaining history and audit records.
